case3_with.summary: Valid monitoring-off ratio draft and correctly identifies unavailable event/denominator/one-sided monitoring. Upstream fallback proposes precomputed weekly changes without saying Measure Level is required; leaving the supplied Change draft would transform them twice. Strict percentile equality also not discussed (not separately penalized).
evidence: The app needs either an event-filtered, aligned input sample containing only qualifying weekly changes, or engine support for that event filter and denominator threshold; plus a one-sided lower-percentile monitor.
Monitoring is therefore off in this draft.

case3_without.summary: Valid monitoring-off weekly ratio draft; identifies unavailable event/25-bp/one-sided filtering and makes no save claim. Omits worked 0.25/10000 arithmetic and an explicit eligible reference-history/sample-sufficiency check. Omitted calculation_contract defaults to v1; this calculation is valid in v1 and no point was deducted for it.
evidence: The app also has no event filter for decision weeks with an absolute policy move of at least 25 bp.
A usable alert needs weekly observations restricted to qualifying policy-decision weeks, using aligned deposit and policy changes, plus a one-sided lower-10th-percentile condition.
